summary: The phase contract holds end to end: the three root and package scripts point at existing CLI files, every scoped flag parses in its CLI (--skip-input-snapshot-pin and --policy v2 on check; --acknowledge, --expected-plan-hash, --owner, --rationale on reconcile; --acknowledge and --budget-s on pin refresh), the CI boundary step at .github/workflows/ci.yml:176 runs the check script with accepted flags and the phase test pins that exact line, the docs describe the CI mode, the refresh command, and the exit codes as the code now works, and live reconcile error runs name the flag and the reason for every wrong or missing flag. No blocking finding. Four nonblocking findings: the docs CI line omits --policy v2, the --budget-s value errors are mislabeled as unsupported-argument errors, no --help output exists on the CLIs, and the docs never document the reconcile command.
nonblocking_findings: The CI section of the docs omits the policy flag. docs/architecture-enforcement.md:111 says GitHub CI runs 'pnpm architecture:check --skip-input-snapshot-pin', but .github/workflows/ci.yml:176 runs 'pnpm architecture:check --skip-input-snapshot-pin --policy v2' (commit 133d5b596). A user who copies the documented command runs the v1 policy check, which plan line 200 says reports a debt change by design. The documented command does not reproduce CI behavior. One-line docs fix routed to Green.

The pin refresh budget flag reports the wrong cause for a bad value. 'pnpm architecture:pin:refresh --budget-s 0' and '--budget-s abc' print 'Unsupported architecture pin refresh argument: --budget-s' (architecture-pin-refresh-cli.ts:114-119). The flag is supported; only the value is invalid. The reconcile CLI does this right ('--policy must be v1 or v2'), so the pattern exists in the same package.

No help output exists on any of the three CLIs. 'tsx src/architecture-reconciliation-cli.ts --help' prints 'Architecture reconciliation failed: Unsupported architecture reconciliation argument: --help' and exits 1. No usage line lists the valid flags or points to docs/architecture-enforcement.md. The error messages for wrong and missing flags are clear on their own (verified live: --policy v3, --acknowledge alone, --owner without value, --expected-plan-hash abc, and a typo flag each name the flag and the reason).

docs/architecture-enforcement.md does not document the architecture:reconcile command at all, including the --owner and --rationale flags this phase added to it (133d5b596; the phase-base CLI at 09168dc4 rejects --owner). The plan records the route and the flags, but the doc file that the phase updated for check and pin:refresh stays silent on reconcile.
